test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: For the financial year 2022-23, which of the following schemes of the Central Government provides an assured pension rate of 7.40% per annum, payable monthly?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (PMVVY) is a pension scheme for senior citizens introduced by the Government of India.
 
• The scheme was launched by the Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) and is available to individuals aged 60 years and above.
 
• For the financial year 2022-23, PMVVY provides an assured pension rate of 7.40% per annum, payable monthly.
 
• The policy term under PMVVY is 10 years, and the pension is payable at the end of each period as per the mode chosen by the subscriber (monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, or yearly).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Varishtha Pension Bima Yojana**

 
 
• This scheme was launched in 2003 and again in 2014 by the Government of India to provide financial security to senior citizens.
 
• It offers a pension based on a guaranteed return on the purchase price.
 
 
 
• **Niryat Rin Vikas Yojana (NIRVIK)**
 
 
• Also known as the Export Credit Insurance Scheme, it aims to provide high insurance cover, reduce premium for small exporters, and simplify the claim settlement process.
 
• The scheme seeks to enhance accessibility and affordability of credit for exporters.
 
 
 
• **Ayushman Sahakar Yojana**
 
 
• Launched by the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare in 2020 to assist cooperatives in playing an important role in the creation of healthcare infrastructure in the country.
 
• The scheme provides financial assistance to cooperatives to set up hospitals, medical colleges, and healthcare facilities.
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (PMVVY)**
 
 
• The scheme was first launched in 2017 and later extended up to 31st March 2023.
 
• The maximum purchase price under the scheme is ₹15 lakhs per senior citizen.
 
• The scheme also provides for the return of the purchase price to the beneficiary on the death of the pensioner during the policy term.
